A1.justification: Both PDFs contain Krause Synchronization Transformers, with all 28 pages and Appendices A-F available. Text comparison and rendered-page inspection support a complete comparison, including equations, tables, figures, and examples.

before.justification: V1 reports original image classification, autoregressive generation, and LLM evaluation results in Section 5 and Appendix D, including accuracy, likelihood, throughput, and ablations.

after.justification: V2 retains the original experimental results in Section 5 and Appendix D, including benchmark measurements, ablations, and qualitative model outputs.

M1.justification: The RBF distance kernel, local neighborhoods, top-k selection, Algorithm 1, and auxiliary Krause Attention pathway for LLMs are identical in both versions.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same classification datasets, MNIST/CIFAR-10 generation and completion tasks, Flan-v2 training subset, and language evaluation benchmarks. No dataset, domain, or test scenario is added or removed.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged throughout: ViT and Swin counterparts, ARM and LARM generation baselines, and base and LoRA-finetuned Llama/Qwen models remain in the same comparisons.

E3.justification: Section 5 and Appendix D retain identical training recipes, model configurations, window/top-k settings, evaluation metrics, zero-shot protocols, and throughput-testing sample counts.

E4.justification: The component and augmentation ablations, window/sparsity sensitivity studies, attention-pattern analyses, image completions, and IFEval examples are unchanged, including all corresponding appendix evidence.

E5.justification: Neither version reports experimental seed counts, repeated-run uncertainty, confidence intervals, or significance tests. The same point-estimate reporting is retained.

E6.justification: All numerical results and qualitative outputs match. For example, Table 5 reports KARM CIFAR-10 BPD of 3.0032 and throughput of 4.5240 images/sec in both versions; the appendix ablation and LLM results also remain identical.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions and derivations are unchanged, including Appendix C's separation assumptions, block-diagonal dynamics, and mean-field convergence arguments, and the equations in Appendix F.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain identical claims about bounded-confidence attention, multi-cluster synchronization, attention-sink mitigation, computational efficiency, and empirical benefits.

C2.justification: Result interpretations and mechanism explanations are identical. Appendix A retains the same qualifications concerning idealized theory, task-dependent hyperparameters, and auxiliary rather than replacement integration into LLMs.

D1.justification: Implementation details, hyperparameters, hardware disclosures, LoRA configuration, prompt examples, and the project-page link are unchanged. The new funding acknowledgment adds no technical or reproducibility information.

R1.justification: The cited works and research positioning are identical, including Section 2 and Appendices B and F. References that move between pages are retained entries, not citation additions or removals.

P1.justification: V2 adds an Acknowledgments paragraph stating support through gifts from Cisco and OpenAI and updates the preprint and arXiv version dates. The scientific prose and appendix organization are unchanged.

P2.justification: The acknowledgment shifts the Impact Statement and reflows the bibliography across pages 9-12, with minor text-spacing changes elsewhere. All figures and tables retain the same content, structure, and placement.

improvement.justification: V2 adds funding attribution and updates dates, accompanied by minor layout reflow. The scientific exposition, evidence, theory, limitations, and reproducibility information remain identical, so these administrative additions leave overall paper quality meaningfully unchanged.
